name: Musashibou Benkei
source:
Originally a member of the Heike clan, the son of Tanzou the Head of Kumano. However he was too rough and was disinherited.
If not a member of the Heike than not as a person he lamented over the decay in the state of the world and the government and awaited revolt.
He had a predestined meeting with the protagonist on the Gojouoo Bridge.
A cheerful man who laughs a lot.
